We are 15 life-long friends, all vegan animal-lovers who moved to Costa Rica in 2005.  We established a non-profit, no-kill charitable organization founded on the belief that all animals deserve respectful and loving treatment and must be protected by humans as well as by law.

Whenever we came across animals who are abused, abandoned, sick or injured, we take action to prevent further suffering and give them a safe and loving home. 

In order to continue to provide food, shelter and veterinary needs for our animals, we are appealing to you for help. 

For just a few dollars a month, you can help a cat or dog continue to live a long and happy life in our cloud forest in Costa Rica

*** To donate, please visit: https://animallove.cr/donate/ ***
